note: What shop assistants say when you talk to them: the greeting, the shop's own line (shop-<room id>), then buttons to browse (the shop panel, as the assistant says pay), write a postcard (rooms in postcard) or say goodbye. The second line is find when the buy guide led you here, else browse. Clips are assistant-<key>, all in the speaker's voice.
speaker: student

browse.zh: 随便看看，有问题就叫我。
browse.pinyin: Suíbiàn kànkan, yǒu wèntí jiù jiào wǒ.
browse.en: Have a look around. Call me if you need anything.

find.pinyin: Nǐ yào zhǎo shénme? Wǒ dài nǐ qù.
find.en: What are you looking for? I'll show you.

pay.pinyin: Zài zhèbiān fù qián jiù kěyǐ le.

shop-supermarket.en: The fruit is very fresh today.

shop-cafe.pinyin: Wǒmen de kāfēi shì xiàn mó de.

shop-bakery.pinyin: Miànbāo gāng chūlú, hái shì rè de.
shop-bakery.en: The bread is fresh out of the oven, still warm.

shop-lifestyle.zh: 买家具可以先看看尺寸。
shop-lifestyle.pinyin: Mǎi jiājù kěyǐ xiān kànkan chǐcùn.
shop-lifestyle.en: When you buy furniture, check the size first.

shop-library.en: The new books are over here by the door.

shop-lights.pinyin: Zhè zhǎn dēng wǎnshang tèbié hǎokàn.
shop-lights.en: This lamp looks especially nice at night.

shop-homeware.zh: 布置房间，从一块地毯开始吧。
shop-homeware.pinyin: Bùzhì fángjiān, cóng yí kuài dìtǎn kāishǐ ba.
shop-homeware.en: To decorate a room, start with a rug.

shop-bank.pinyin: Qǐng xiān ná hào, shāo děng yíxià.
shop-bank.en: Please take a number first and wait a moment.

shop-post-office.pinyin: Jì xìn qǐng zài zhèlǐ mǎi yóupiào.
shop-post-office.en: To send a letter, buy stamps here.

shop-pharmacy.zh: 哪里不舒服？我帮你看看。
shop-pharmacy.pinyin: Nǎlǐ bù shūfu? Wǒ bāng nǐ kànkan.
shop-pharmacy.en: Where do you feel unwell? Let me help.

shop-hardware.zh: 你要修什么？我帮你找工具。
shop-hardware.pinyin: Nǐ yào xiū shénme? Wǒ bāng nǐ zhǎo gōngjù.
shop-hardware.en: What do you need to fix? I'll help you find the tools.

shop-clothes-shop.pinyin: Zhè jiàn yīfu nǐ kěyǐ shìshi.
shop-clothes-shop.en: You could try this one on.

shop-teahouse.pinyin: Lái yì hú chá ba, mànmàn hē.
shop-teahouse.en: Have a pot of tea, and take your time.
